5: ``detect`` template with a query image whose mean-pooled vision embedding gets
6: spliced into the same prompt slot::
7: 
8:     [BOS, image patches] [detect prefix] [* mean_pool(vis_enc(query_crop)) *] [detect suffix]
9:                                           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
10:                        text path : tokenizer.encode(" " + class_name)
11:                        visual path: this trainer
12: 
13: Training-time supervision is identical to ``sft_trainer.py``: teacher-forced
14: cross-entropy on the region head's coordinate / size bins for each GT box.
15: 
16: Trainable parameter set (v1):
17: - LoRA on the text decoder layers (qkv, proj, fc1, fc2)
18: - LoRA on the vision projection MLP (vision.proj_mlp.fc1, vision.proj_mlp.fc2)
19:   — this is the only adapter on the path query_crop -> splice_position
20: - Full fine-tune of model.region
21: 
22: The base ViT backbone is run under ``torch.no_grad()`` for both the target
23: image (frozen) and the query crop (we only need gradients through the
24: ``proj_mlp`` LoRA, so the encoder activations don't need to be retained).
25:

149:     """Mean-pool the query's projected patch tokens to a (1, 1, D) prompt slot."""
150:     tokens = _run_query_encoder(model, query_image)        # (729, D)
151:     # TODO: eventually try other methods of combining.
152:     pooled = tokens.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True).unsqueeze(0)  # (1, 1, D)
153:     return pooled

157: # Per-sample loss (mirrors teacher_forced_region_loss in sft_trainer.py)
158: # ============================================================================

161: def teacher_forced_visual_prompt_loss(
162:     model: MoondreamModel,
163:     query_crop,
164:     target_image,
165:     boxes: torch.Tensor,
166:     max_objects: Optional[int] = None,
167: ) -> torch.Tensor:
168:     """Teacher-forced detection loss with the visual-prompt slot.
169: 
170:     Args:
171:         model: Moondream 2 model.
172:         query_crop: PIL image — single instance of the class to detect.
173:         target_image: PIL image — image to detect that class in.
174:         boxes: tensor of shape (N, 4), each [x_min, y_min, w, h] in [0, 1].
175:         max_objects: cap on number of supervised GT boxes per call.
176:     """
177:     if boxes.numel() == 0:
178:         return torch.zeros([], device=model.device)
179: 
180:     detect_template = model.config.tokenizer.templates["detect"]
181:     prefix_ids = detect_template["prefix"]
182:     suffix_ids = detect_template["suffix"]
183: 
184:     # Target image is frozen — same as usual.
185:     with torch.no_grad():
186:         encoded_target = encode_image_grad(model, target_image, settings=None)
187:     model.load_encoded_image(encoded_target)
188:     pos = encoded_target.pos
189: 
190:     # Build the new visual-prompt embedding: [prefix_text, query_pooled, suffix_text].
191:     pre = text_encoder(
192:         torch.tensor([prefix_ids], device=model.device, dtype=torch.long), model.text
193:     )
194:     suf = text_encoder(
195:         torch.tensor([suffix_ids], device=model.device, dtype=torch.long), model.text
196:     )
197:     q_pooled = _query_emb_pooled(model, query_crop)            # (1, 1, D), grads on
198:     prompt_emb = torch.cat([pre, q_pooled, suf], dim=1)         # (1, L, D)
199:     L = prompt_emb.size(1)
200: 
201:     mask = model.attn_mask[:, :, pos : pos + L, :]
202:     pos_ids = torch.arange(pos, pos + L, device=model.device, dtype=torch.long)
203:     hidden_BC = _prefill(model, prompt_emb, mask, pos_ids)      # (1, L, D)
204:     pos = pos + L
205:     hidden = hidden_BC[:, -1:, :]
206: 
207:     # Subsequent one-token decode steps use a 2048-wide causal mask.
208:     step_mask = torch.zeros(1, 1, 2048, device=model.device, dtype=torch.bool)
209:     step_mask[:, :, :pos] = 1
210: 
211:     n = boxes.size(0) if max_objects is None else min(boxes.size(0), max_objects)
212:     total_loss = torch.zeros([], device=model.device)
213:     n_terms = 0
214: 
215:     for obj_idx in range(n):
216:         bb = boxes[obj_idx].to(model.device)
217:         x_min, y_min, w_box, h_box = bb
218:         x_center = torch.clamp(x_min + w_box / 2.0, 0.0, 1.0)
219:         y_center = torch.clamp(y_min + h_box / 2.0, 0.0, 1.0)
220: 
221:         # ---- X bin CE ----
222:         x_logits = decode_coordinate(hidden, model.region)
223:         x_target = torch.tensor(
224:             [coord_to_bin(float(x_center))], device=model.device, dtype=torch.long,
225:         )
226:         total_loss = total_loss + F.cross_entropy(
227:             x_logits.view(-1, x_logits.size(-1)), x_target
228:         )
229:         n_terms += 1
230: 
231:         x_t = (
232:             x_center.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(-1).to(dtype=x_logits.dtype)
233:         )
234:         next_emb = encode_coordinate(x_t, model.region)
235:         step_mask[:, :, pos] = 1
236:         pos_ids = torch.tensor([pos], device=model.device, dtype=torch.long)
237:         _, hidden = _decode_one_tok(model, next_emb, step_mask, pos_ids)
238:         pos += 1
239: 
240:         # ---- Y bin CE ----
241:         y_logits = decode_coordinate(hidden, model.region)
242:         y_target = torch.tensor(
243:             [coord_to_bin(float(y_center))], device=model.device, dtype=torch.long,
244:         )
245:         total_loss = total_loss + F.cross_entropy(
246:             y_logits.view(-1, y_logits.size(-1)), y_target
247:         )
248:         n_terms += 1
249: 
250:         y_t = (
251:             y_center.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(-1).to(dtype=y_logits.dtype)
252:         )
253:         next_emb = encode_coordinate(y_t, model.region)
254:         step_mask[:, :, pos] = 1
255:         pos_ids = torch.tensor([pos], device=model.device, dtype=torch.long)
256:         _, hidden = _decode_one_tok(model, next_emb, step_mask, pos_ids)
257:         pos += 1
258: 
259:         # ---- Size (w, h) bin CE ----
260:         size_logits = decode_size(hidden, model.region)         # (2, 1024)
261:         w_bin = size_to_bin(float(w_box))
262:         h_bin = size_to_bin(float(h_box))
263:         total_loss = total_loss + F.cross_entropy(
264:             size_logits[0].unsqueeze(0),
265:             torch.tensor([w_bin], device=model.device, dtype=torch.long),
266:         )
267:         total_loss = total_loss + F.cross_entropy(
268:             size_logits[1].unsqueeze(0),
269:             torch.tensor([h_bin], device=model.device, dtype=torch.long),
270:         )
271:         n_terms += 2
272: 
273:         size_t = torch.tensor(
274:             [bin_to_size(w_bin), bin_to_size(h_bin)],
275:             device=model.device, dtype=size_logits.dtype,
276:         )
277:         next_emb = encode_size(size_t, model.region).unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)
278:         step_mask[:, :, pos] = 1
279:         pos_ids = torch.tensor([pos], device=model.device, dtype=torch.long)
280:         _, hidden = _decode_one_tok(model, next_emb, step_mask, pos_ids)
281:         pos += 1
282: 
283:     return total_loss / max(n_terms, 1)
284:

291: @torch.inference_mode()
292: def detect_with_visual_prompt(
293:     model: MoondreamModel,
294:     target_image,
295:     query_image,
296:     max_objects: int = 25,
297: ) -> list[dict]:
298:     """Run detection using a query image as the prompt instead of a text label.
299: 
300:     Returns a list of {x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max} dicts in [0, 1] coords.
301:     """
302:     encoded = model.encode_image(target_image)
303:     model.load_encoded_image(encoded)
304: 
305:     detect_template = model.config.tokenizer.templates["detect"]
306:     pre = text_encoder(
307:         torch.tensor([detect_template["prefix"]], device=model.device), model.text
308:     )
309:     suf = text_encoder(
310:         torch.tensor([detect_template["suffix"]], device=model.device), model.text
311:     )
312:     q_pooled = _query_emb_pooled(model, query_image)
313:     prompt_emb = torch.cat([pre, q_pooled, suf], dim=1)
314:     L = prompt_emb.size(1)
315: 
316:     pos = encoded.pos
317:     mask = model.attn_mask[:, :, pos : pos + L, :]
318:     pos_ids = torch.arange(pos, pos + L, device=model.device, dtype=torch.long)
319:     hidden = _prefill(model, prompt_emb, mask, pos_ids)
320:     logits = lm_head(hidden, model.text)
321:     next_token = torch.argmax(logits, dim=-1).unsqueeze(1)
322:     return model._generate_points(
323:         hidden[:, -1:, :], next_token, pos + L,
324:         include_size=True, max_objects=max_objects,
325:     )

369: def validate_visual_prompt(
370:     model: MoondreamModel,
371:     val_ds: LVISVisualPrompting,
372:     step: int,
373:     max_samples: int = 250,
374:     iou_threshold: float = 0.5,
375:     max_plot_samples: int = 16,
376:     log_to_wandb: bool = True,
377:     predictions_dir: str = "predictions",
378: ) -> dict:
379:     """F1 / precision / recall against GT, using detect_with_visual_prompt.
380: 
381:     Also saves up to ``max_plot_samples`` side-by-side prediction figures into
382:     ``predictions_dir`` and logs them to wandb under ``predictions/vp`` (when
383:     ``log_to_wandb``).
384:     """
385:     model.eval()
386:     os.makedirs(predictions_dir, exist_ok=True)
387:     n = min(max_samples, len(val_ds))
388:     TP = FP = FN = 0
389:     images: list = []
390:     with torch.no_grad():
391:         for i in tqdm(range(n), desc=f"validate@step={step}", leave=False):
392:             sample = val_ds[i]
393:             preds = detect_with_visual_prompt(
394:                 model, sample["target_image"], sample["query_crop"],
395:             )
396:             gt_dicts = [_xywh_to_corner_dict(b) for b in sample["boxes"]]
397:             tp, fp, fn = match_boxes_score(preds, gt_dicts, iou_threshold=iou_threshold)
398:             TP += tp; FP += fp; FN += fn
399: 
400:             if i < max_plot_samples:
401:                 try:
402:                     fig = _plot_vp_prediction(
403:                         sample["query_crop"], sample["target_image"],
404:                         gt_dicts, preds, sample["class_name"], tp, fp, fn,
405:                     )
406:                     fig_path = os.path.join(
407:                         predictions_dir, f"vp_step{step}_{i:03d}.png"
408:                     )
409:                     fig.savefig(fig_path, dpi=90, bbox_inches="tight")
410:                     plt.close(fig)
411:                     if log_to_wandb:
412:                         images.append(wandb.Image(fig_path, caption=sample["class_name"]))
413:                 except Exception as e:
414:                     logging.warning(f"failed to save prediction figure {i}: {e}")
415: 
416:     if log_to_wandb and images:
417:         try:
418:             wandb.log({"predictions/vp": images}, step=step)
419:         except Exception as e:
420:             logging.warning(f"failed to log prediction images to wandb: {e}")
421: 
422:     model.train()
423:     if torch.cuda.is_available():
424:         torch.cuda.empty_cache()
425: 
426:     precision = TP / (TP + FP) if (TP + FP) else 0.0
427:     recall = TP / (TP + FN) if (TP + FN) else 0.0
428:     f1 = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall) if (precision + recall) else 0.0
429:     return {"precision": precision, "recall": recall, "f1": f1, "tp": TP, "fp": FP, "fn": FN}

449:     text_lora_targets: Optional[list] = None,
450:     proj_mlp_lora_rank: int = 8,
451:     proj_mlp_lora_alpha: int = 16,
452:     proj_mlp_lora_dropout: float = 0.0,
453:     max_objects_per_sample: int = 10,
454:     # Dataset
455:     dataset_name: str = "Voxel51/LVIS",
456:     max_samples: int = 5000,
457:     num_triplets_per_epoch: int = 10_000,
458:     hold_out_classes: bool = True,
459:     train_ratio: float = 0.9,
460:     val_ratio: float = 0.05,
461:     split_seed: int = 0,
462:     # IO
463:     model_path: str = "moondream2/model.safetensors",
464:     wandb_project: str = "moondream-visual-prompt-ft",
465:     run_name: Optional[str] = None,
466:     artifact_dir: str = "model_artifacts",
467:     predictions_dir: str = "predictions",
468: ):
469:     """Train Moondream 2 with visual prompts via LoRA on text decoder + proj_mlp."""
470:     if text_lora_targets is None:
471:         text_lora_targets = ["qkv", "proj", "fc1", "fc2"]
472: 
473:     logging.basicConfig(
474:         level=logging.INFO,
475:         format="%(asctime)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s",
476:     )
477:     # Quiet noisy third-party loggers — httpx in particular spams a line per
478:     # HTTP request during the first FiftyOne download, swamping training logs.
479:     for noisy in ("httpx", "httpcore", "urllib3", "fiftyone"):
480:         logging.getLogger(noisy).setLevel(logging.WARNING)
481: 
482:     os.makedirs(predictions_dir, exist_ok=True)
483:     os.makedirs(artifact_dir, exist_ok=True)
484:     logging.info(f"Artifact dir:    {artifact_dir}")
485:     logging.info(f"Predictions dir: {predictions_dir}")
486: 
487:     wandb.init(
488:         project=wandb_project,
489:         name=run_name,
490:         config=dict(
491:             EPOCHS=epochs, GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS=grad_accum_steps, LR=lr,
492:             VALIDATION_SAMPLES=validation_samples, EVAL_INTERVAL=eval_interval,
493:             EARLY_STOPPING_PATIENCE=early_stopping_patience,
494:             OVERFIT_BATCH_SIZE=overfit_batch_size,
495:             LORA_RANK=lora_rank, LORA_ALPHA=lora_alpha, LORA_DROPOUT=lora_dropout,
496:             TEXT_LORA_TARGETS=text_lora_targets,
497:             PROJ_MLP_LORA_RANK=proj_mlp_lora_rank,
498:             PROJ_MLP_LORA_ALPHA=proj_mlp_lora_alpha,
499:             MAX_OBJECTS_PER_SAMPLE=max_objects_per_sample,
500:             DATASET=dataset_name, MAX_SAMPLES=max_samples,
501:             NUM_TRIPLETS_PER_EPOCH=num_triplets_per_epoch,
502:             HOLD_OUT_CLASSES=hold_out_classes,
503:             RUN_NAME=run_name,
504:             ARTIFACT_DIR=artifact_dir,
505:             PREDICTIONS_DIR=predictions_dir,
506:             md_version="2", trainer="visual_prompt_teacher_forced",
507:         ),
508:     )
509: 
510:     # Build and load the base model.
511:     model = MoondreamModel(config=MoondreamConfig(), setup_caches=True)
512:     model.load_state_dict(load_file(model_path))
513:     model.to(device)
514:     for _, buf in model.named_buffers():
515:         buf.data = buf.data.to(device)
516: 
517:     # Inject LoRA on the text decoder 
518:     inject_lora_into_model(
519:         model, rank=lora_rank, alpha=lora_alpha, dropout=lora_dropout,
520:         target_modules=text_lora_targets,
521:     )
522:     # Inject LoRA on the vision.proj_mlp
523:     inject_lora_into_proj_mlp(
524:         model, rank=proj_mlp_lora_rank, alpha=proj_mlp_lora_alpha,
525:         dropout=proj_mlp_lora_dropout,
526:     )
527: 
528:     # Freeze everything, then re-enable: LoRA params + region head.
529:     for p in model.parameters():
530:         p.requires_grad = False
531:     for module in model.modules():
532:         if isinstance(module, LoRALinear):
533:             module.lora_A.requires_grad = True
534:             module.lora_B.requires_grad = True
535:     for p in model.region.parameters(): 
536:         p.requires_grad = True
537: 
538:     total_params = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
539:     trainable_params = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
540:     logging.info(f"Total parameters:    {total_params:,}")
541:     logging.info(f"Trainable params:    {trainable_params:,}")
542:     logging.info(f"Trainable ratio:     {100 * trainable_params / total_params:.3f}%")
543: 
544:     optimizer = AdamW(
545:         [{"params": [p for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad]}], lr=lr,
546:     )
547: 
548:     # Datasets — load the FiftyOne dataset *once* and share it across splits.
549:     fo_dataset = load_lvis_fo(dataset_name, max_samples=max_samples)
550:     common = dict(
551:         dataset_name=dataset_name, max_samples=max_samples,
552:         hold_out_classes=hold_out_classes, train_ratio=train_ratio,
553:         val_ratio=val_ratio, split_seed=split_seed,
554:         fo_dataset=fo_dataset,
555:     )
556:     train_ds = LVISVisualPrompting(
557:         split="train", num_triplets_per_epoch=num_triplets_per_epoch, **common,
558:     )
559:     val_ds = LVISVisualPrompting(
560:         split="val", num_triplets_per_epoch=validation_samples, **common,
561:     )
562:     test_ds = LVISVisualPrompting(
563:         split="test", num_triplets_per_epoch=validation_samples, **common,
564:     )
565: 
566:     if overfit_batch_size is not None and overfit_batch_size > 0:
567:         logging.info(
568:             f"Overfit mode: training and validating on the first "
569:             f"{overfit_batch_size} sampled triplets."
570:         )
571:         train_ds.num_triplets = overfit_batch_size
572:         val_ds.num_triplets = overfit_batch_size
573:         test_ds.num_triplets = overfit_batch_size
574: 
575:     logging.info(f"Train classes: {len(train_ds.classes)} (split={train_ds.split})")
576:     logging.info(f"Val   classes: {len(val_ds.classes)} (split={val_ds.split})")
577:     logging.info(f"Test  classes: {len(test_ds.classes)} (split={test_ds.split})")
578:     if hold_out_classes:
579:         overlap = set(train_ds.classes) & set(val_ds.classes)
580:         if overlap:
581:             logging.warning(f"train/val class overlap (should be empty): {len(overlap)}")
582: 
583:     # Initial validation (on novel classes if hold_out_classes=True).
584:     initial = validate_visual_prompt(
585:         model, val_ds, step=0, max_samples=validation_samples,
586:         max_plot_samples=val_plot_samples,
587:         predictions_dir=predictions_dir,
588:     )
589:     best_f1 = initial["f1"]
590:     best_step = 0
591:     logging.info(f"Initial val f1: {initial['f1']:.4f}  (P={initial['precision']:.3f}, R={initial['recall']:.3f})")
592:     wandb.log(
593:         {f"initial/{k}": v for k, v in initial.items()},
594:         step=0,
595:     )
596: 
597:     total_steps = max(1, epochs * len(train_ds) // grad_accum_steps)
598:     pbar = tqdm(total=total_steps)
599: 
600:     model.train()
601:     i = 0
602:     accum_loss_sum = 0.0
603:     accum_loss_n = 0
604:     evals_without_improvement = 0
605:     should_stop = False
606:     for epoch in range(epochs):
607:         for sample in train_ds:
608:             i += 1
609:             loss = teacher_forced_visual_prompt_loss(
610:                 model,
611:                 sample["query_crop"],
612:                 sample["target_image"],
613:                 sample["boxes"],
614:                 max_objects=max_objects_per_sample,
615:             )
616:             (loss / grad_accum_steps).backward()
617:             accum_loss_sum += float(loss.item())
618:             accum_loss_n += 1
619: 
620:             if i % grad_accum_steps == 0:
621:                 optimizer.step()
622:                 optimizer.zero_grad()
623: 
624:                 step = i // grad_accum_steps
625:                 lr_val = lr_schedule(step, total_steps, base_lr=lr)
626:                 for pg in optimizer.param_groups:
627:                     pg["lr"] = lr_val
628: 
629:                 avg_loss = accum_loss_sum / max(accum_loss_n, 1)
630:                 accum_loss_sum, accum_loss_n = 0.0, 0
631:                 pbar.set_postfix({"step": step, "loss": f"{avg_loss:.4f}"})
632:                 pbar.update(1)
633:                 wandb.log(
634:                     {"loss/train": avg_loss, "lr": lr_val, "epoch": epoch},
635:                     step=step,
636:                 )
637: 
638:                 if step % eval_interval == 0 and step > 0:
639:                     val = validate_visual_prompt(
640:                         model, val_ds, step=step, max_samples=validation_samples,
641:                         max_plot_samples=val_plot_samples,
642:                         predictions_dir=predictions_dir,
643:                     )
644:                     logging.info(
645:                         f"step={step}  val f1={val['f1']:.4f}  "
646:                         f"P={val['precision']:.3f}  R={val['recall']:.3f}"
647:                     )
648:                     wandb.log(
649:                         {f"val/{k}": v for k, v in val.items()},
650:                         step=step,
651:                     )
652: 
653:                     if val["f1"] > best_f1:
654:                         best_f1 = val["f1"]
655:                         best_step = step
656:                         evals_without_improvement = 0
657:                         save_file(
658:                             get_lora_state_dict(model, include_region=True),
